description_en: Resets the password of a user
kebab_example: aliyun cloudsso reset-user-password --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --user-id u-00q8wbq42wiltcrk0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetUserPassword

parameters.help_en:
The new password.

The password must contain the following types of characters: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.

The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length.

If you set `GenerateRandomPassword` to `False`, you must specify `Password`
parameters.help_zh:
新密码。

格式：必须包含大写英文字母、小写英文字母、数字、特殊符号每种至少各一个。

长度：8~32个字符。

当`GenerateRandomPassword`为`False`时，您需要设置`Password`
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the system to automatically generate a new password. Valid values:

True: The new password is automatically generated by the system.

False: The new password must be manually specified. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动生成密码。取值：

True：自动生成密码。
False（默认值）：手动设置密码
parameters.name: generate_random_password

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether password reset is required upon the next logon. Valid values:

True: Password reset is required upon the next logon.

False: Password reset is not required upon the next logon. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
用户下次登录时是否需要重置密码。取值：

True：需要重置。
False（默认值）：不需要重置
parameters.name: require_password_reset_for_next_login

NewPassword.description_en:
The new password.

This parameter is returned only when the new password is automatically generated by the system
NewPassword.description_zh:
新密码。

该参数仅在系统自动生成密码时显示
